title: Coq au Vin
subtitle: Chicken legs braised with pancetta, mushrooms, and herbs
excerpt: Chicken legs are browned, then slow-braised with pancetta, chestnut mushrooms, carrots, and herbs in a stock-based sauce. Red wine vinegar stands in here for the traditional wine. The result is a deeply savoury braise that improves if made a day ahead.
sourceNotes: Based on the French farmhouse braise. Red wine vinegar replaces the wine and gives a similar depth and acidity without the alcohol.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze without the mushrooms. Add freshly cooked mushrooms when reheating.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Make a day ahead and refrigerate. Skim any fat from the top and reheat gently.

content.text: Brown the chicken well before braising. The deep colour you get in the pan translates directly to flavour in the final sauce. Do not rush this step.

items.prepNote: used in place of red wine

content.text: Pat the chicken legs dry. Season with salt. Dust lightly with plain flour on all sides.
Melt half the butter in a large stockpot over medium-high heat. Brown the chicken in two batches for 4 minutes each side. Remove and set aside.
Add the pancetta to the same pot. Fry for 4 minutes until golden. Remove and set aside.
Add the remaining butter. Cook the onion, carrot, and celery over medium heat for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic. Cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the tomato puree. Cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the red wine vinegar. Let it bubble for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken stock, thyme, and bay leaves. Return the chicken and pancetta to the pot.
Bring to a boil. Reduce to a low simmer. Cover and cook for 45 minutes.
Add the mushrooms. Cook uncovered for 15 more minutes until the sauce has reduced and the chicken is very tender.
Taste and adjust salt. Remove the thyme stems and bay leaves. Serve with mashed potato or crusty bread.

items.cause: Too much liquid, not reduced enough
items.fix: Remove chicken and boil sauce hard for 10 minutes.

items.cause: Vinegar was not cooked off properly
items.fix: Add a pinch of sugar and simmer 5 more minutes.

items.cause: Skin was not browned well enough at the start
items.fix: Brown more aggressively next time before braising.
